About Compound

Compound is one of the earliest decentralized lending protocols on Ethereum. COMP is used to govern the protocol.

Where this COMP price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (COMP-USD), Binance (COMP/USDT) and Kraken (COMP/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 9,468,480 COMP (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
